interface.name: zsingularity_brightness_manager_v1

description.summary: dim outputs that have no brightness control

interface.description: Lets the desktop shell lower the brightness of an output by scaling its gamma ramp, for displays whose backlight cannot be controlled. The ramp is combined with the one set through gamma control, so night light keeps working, and it applies at scanout, so screenshots and recordings are not affected. The compositor never goes below a minimum level, and the value stays in effect after the client disconnects.

request.name: set_brightness

description.summary: set the software brightness of an output

request.description: Sets the level in thousandths, where 1000 means no dimming. Values below the compositor minimum are raised to it.

event.name: reset
event.description: Sent after the user pressed the reset shortcut. Every output is back to full brightness and clients should forget the levels they set.
